import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_wine
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, cross_val_score

X, y = load_wine(return_X_y=True, as_frame=True)

from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

knn_pipe = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), KNeighborsClassifier())
logreg_pipe = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000))

knn_mean = cross_val_score(knn_pipe, X, y, cv=5).mean()
lr_mean = cross_val_score(logreg_pipe, X, y, cv=5).mean()
print(f'knn {knn_mean:.3f}  logreg {lr_mean:.3f}')
print('better:', 'knn' if knn_mean < lr_mean else 'logreg')
